name: departments
title: Departments
summary: The app's department pages opened from the home Departments rail: the Phones (standalone phones staff add), Blogs (topics, staff authors, posts, reactions, replies and reports), the Companies directory (industries, company pages, inquiries) and the Play center (games and ranking tables). Staff manage all of it in Admin › Departments.
owns: Phones: standalone phones staff add for the Phone tab (brand, name, overview, storage sizes with prices, colors, preview photos, full-size advertisement images, a grouped spec sheet), in order. No ordering: the page links to a store search
Farm machines: machine types and the machines staff pick (catalog products, bought through cart and checkout) with their attachments
Blogs: topics, author profiles, posts (sanitized rich text, cover, publish state), likes and dislikes, customer replies, reports and their review
Companies: industries, company pages (logo, photos, description, contacts, map location, verified mark) and customer inquiries
Play center: games (list only at this phase: no playing inside the app) and the ranking tables staff keep per game and period
Blog saves, author follows and reply likes of customers
Company and game reviews (1–5 stars, one per customer) and their moderation
Play center scores: player IDs, per-game server keys for game partners, posted scores, rankings computed from them, prize weeks and the coupons won (promotions.issueCode)
notOwns: Buying a phone: the Phone tab only shows information; Find in store opens the store search
The Departments rail itself (titles, icons, destinations): content (homepage section kind departments)
The carousel ads at the top of Companies and Play center: advertising (placements companies_top, play_top)

publicApi.name: linkTargets
publicApi.signature: (input: { kind: 'phone', q?: string, ids?: string[], slugs?: string[], limit?: int }) => LinkTarget[]
publicApi.desc: Link targets for ad destination pickers (search by q, or resolve ids or URL slugs): phones of the Phones department (/phones/{slug}; available when published), each with its store path the app opens, a label, a short meta line, an image and whether it is shown in the store. Unknown ids are left out.

publicApi.name: getFarmMachine
publicApi.desc: A picked farm machine with its attachments as product cards (prices and availability now), like GET /farm/machines/{productId}; NOT_FOUND when it isn't picked or the store no longer shows it. Farm orders price machines and attachments with it.

publicApi.name: farmMachineTypes
publicApi.desc: The Farm machines department's type (id and name) for each picked machine, keyed by product id, for grouping farm orders by machine type. Products that are not picked any more, or whose type has been removed, are left out rather than failing, so old orders can still be counted.

publicApi.name: exportCustomerData
publicApi.desc: The customer's blog reactions, replies, reports, saved posts, followed authors and reply likes; company inquiries; company and game reviews; Play center player ID, scores and prize coupons, for the personal data export. Reactions, replies, reports and inquiries are kept by account id, the rest by customers-module id (both ids are looked up everywhere)

jobs.name: departments.import-phone-picks
jobs.does: Once: turns the products picked for the Phone tab before standalone phones (phone_picks, id phones) into phones, in the same order: brand and title, description as overview, storage sizes from the product variants' storage or capacity option (else one Standard row) with the price of its search card, color options (a grey swatch when the color name is unknown), the product images as photos (attached as content_block usages) and its specs as one Specifications group; then empties product_ids so it never runs again. A phone whose slug already exists counts as imported. Products catalog cannot read or search shows no price for are skipped and logged; while catalog or search is off the picks wait for a later start.

jobs.name: departments.award-prize-weeks
jobs.does: For every game with prize tiers linked to coupon campaigns, works out the winners of each prize week that ended at least scoreMaxAgeMinutes ago (the last 4 weeks), issues each winner's coupon with promotions.issueCode (key play:<game>:<week>:<customer>, so a retry gives the same code) and publishes departments.play.prize_awarded. Winners whose code could not be issued are tried again next hour.

settings.desc: Customers can reply to blog posts
How old a posted score may be; a prize week is settled this long after it ends, so no late score can change it

SLUG_TAKEN.meaning: Another record already uses this slug.

IN_USE.meaning: Posts or companies still use it; move or delete them first.

REVIEWS_NOT_ALLOWED.meaning: This account can't write reviews right now.

TOO_MANY_KEYS.meaning: The game already has two active server keys; revoke or rotate one.

UNKNOWN_PLAYER.meaning: No customer has this player ID.

GAME_NOT_ACTIVE.meaning: The game is hidden and takes no scores.

SCORE_ID_REUSED.meaning: This scoreId was already used for a different player or score.

SCORE_TOO_OLD.meaning: The score was played too long ago (or in the future) to count.

notes: Phones are standalone records (2026-10-23 decision): staff add them in Admin › Departments › Phones with prices, options, a spec sheet, preview photos and advertisement images; there is no ordering. The app page has Detail and Advertisements tabs (2026-10-23: the second tab shows its own advertisement images, not the gallery photos) and a Find in store button that opens the store search for searchTerm.
Department pages exist only in the app for now (2026-10-21 decision): the web store has no pages for these endpoints yet.
Blog posts are written by staff under author profiles; customers react, reply and report (2026-10-21 decision). Replies are shown at once and hidden by staff when needed.
Play center is list-only at this phase (2026-10-21 decision): games and the ranking tables staff keep. Game.playable is false: games are not played inside the app.

Play center scores (2026-10-22 decision): a game partner's server posts scores to POST /webhooks/departments/play/scores with the game's server key (X-Game-Key; staff make, rotate and revoke keys, shown once, kept as SHA-256 hashes). The customer is named by their player ID (GET /play/player, a stable code like MK-7F3K-92QD). Rankings (today, this week, all time) are each player's best score in the period, ties going to whoever reached it first, names shown as first name and last initial. A game without posted scores keeps its staff-kept table.

Prize weeks run Monday–Sunday in the market time zone. Each prize tier names its ranks and a promotions coupon campaign; the hourly departments.award-prize-weeks job settles a week scoreMaxAgeMinutes after it ends, gives each winner their own code (promotions.issueCode, idempotent per game, week and winner) and publishes departments.play.prize_awarded for the notification (coupons show in Account › Coupons).

Blog saves, follows, reply likes, reviews and player IDs key customers by their customers-module id (the store principal's customerId, else the account id), as promotions and notifications do. Reactions, replies and reports keep the account id they always used.

Company and game reviews: 1–5 stars and an optional text, one per customer and target, changed by posting again; the name is the customer's first name and last initial. Ratings count visible reviews only; staff hide or show reviews in Admin › Departments › Reviews.

Bodies are sanitized HTML with the same allow-list as content's news and help (a copy of content domain rules sanitizeHtml, since modules don't import each other's files). Pictures are content_image uploads attached with media.attach to the record that shows them.
Slugs are made from the name or title when omitted (lowercase words joined by -) and must be unique per table; a taken slug answers SLUG_TAKEN.
A reply's authorName is the customer's first name and last initial when it was written (customers.getProfile), else Customer.

Farm machines are ordered in farm orders (farm module, 2026-10-22 decision 3; it replaced the 2026-10-21 cart and checkout flow): the app quotes and places the machine with the chosen attachments there. Renting is left out of v1.
